content.text: Create exactly one isolated neutral standing key pose of this exact violet archer, facing east/right. Use the supplied approved south-facing production sprite as the binding design: same compact slim four-head-tall body, small hood, simple dark-violet clothing, lavender accents, light armor only, narrow asymmetrical bow and no cape expansion. Stand upright at rest with a narrow silhouette; no crouching, attack draw, heavy armor, oversized shoulders or heroic enlargement. Fixed 3/4 top-down camera, upper-left light. Crisp low-resolution pixel art with hard pixels and no antialiasing. Centered, fully visible. Flat pure magenta #FF00FF background only; no floor, shadow, particles, text, border, logo or duplicate. Do not use magenta in the character.
